description: Hyperliquid builder codes (front-ends and bots that attach their address to an order and take a slice of the taker fee), by `view`. `leaderboard`: builders ranked by fee revenue, routed volume, unique users or fills over a window. `stats`: venue-wide builder economics. `profile`: one builder's totals with per-symbol and per-dex breakdowns, user-volume deciles and lifetime totals. `users`: the wallets routing through one builder. `fills`: its raw routed fills (sum `fee_usd`; `fee` is in its own `fee_token`). `series`: fee, volume, users and fills per hour or day (`users` is NOT additive across buckets). `fee_usd` is the builder's own cut, `trader_fee_usd` what the trader paid; every `*_pct` is percentage points 0-100. History depth differs by builder: compare `active_days` and `window` before comparing windows. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/builders and its sub-routes.

breakdown_limit.description: Rows per breakdown (per-symbol and per-dex). Max 1000. Used by view: profile.

bucket.description: Bucket width: `1h` or `1d`. Used by view: series.

builder.description: Builder address: 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Used by view: profile, users, fills, series. Required by view: profile, users, fills, series.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, passed back verbatim; it is null on the last page. Omit it for the first page. Used by view: leaderboard, users, fills, series.

end.description: ISO-8601 UTC upper bound, e.g. 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z. Used by view: fills, series.

limit.description: Rows per page. Default by view: leaderboard 50, users 100, fills 100, series 500. Max by view: leaderboard 500, users 1000, fills 5000, series 2000. Used by view: leaderboard, users, fills, series.

order.description: `desc` or `asc`. Used by view: leaderboard, users.

side.description: `buy` or `sell`. Omit for both. Used by view: fills.

sort.description: `leaderboard`: `fee` (the builder's own cut), `volume`, `users` or `fills`. `users`: `volume`, `fees` or `pnl` (the TRADERS' signed realized PnL, not the builder's). Default by view: leaderboard fee, users volume. Used by view: leaderboard, users.

start.description: ISO-8601 UTC lower bound, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Used by view: fills, series.

symbol.description: Hyperliquid instrument ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, HYPE; a HIP-3 market is `dex:TICKER`, e.g. xyz:TSLA. Omit for all symbols. Used by view: fills.

view.description: What to read. `leaderboard`: builders ranked by fee revenue, volume, users or fills. `stats`: venue-wide builder-code economics. `profile`: one builder's totals with per-symbol and per-dex breakdowns. `users`: the wallets routing through one builder, ranked. `fills`: one builder's raw routed fills, newest first. `series`: one builder's fee, volume, users and fills per hour or day. Default `leaderboard`.

window.description: Window: `1d`, `7d`, `30d` or `all`. Used by view: leaderboard, stats, profile, users.

name: hl_builders
title: Hyperliquid Builders
